content: EF Core 10 (LTS, Nov 2025, supported to Nov 2028): complex types now support optional complex types, struct complex types, table-splitting and ToJson() mapping (collections only via JSON); complex types preferred over owned types for value objects; ExecuteUpdateAsync accepts non-expression lambda and supports JSON complex props; named query filters HasQueryFilter(name, ...) + IgnoreQueryFilters([names]); parameterized collections default to padded multiple scalar params; LeftJoin/RightJoin LINQ; DateOnly.DayNumber/ToDateTime translation; inlined constants redacted from logs; raw-SQL concatenation analyzer; json column type used automatically at compat level 170 (SQL 2025). Source learn.microsoft.com/ef/core/what-is-new/ef-core-10.0/whatsnew.
